description.text: T-Hub is India's pioneering startup enabler in Hyderabad, connecting founders with corporates, investors, government and academia.

targetApplicants.text: Three real-world challenges for Indian startups: disaster awareness, crop health and zero-waste communities. ₹10 lakh prize pool, Challenge Day at T-Hub on 24 November.
